title: Parking, Lake Rules, & New Gas Stations
summary:
*   **Traffic & Parking:** Expanded existing parking meter zones within the city.
*   **Lake Austin Development:** Approved a marine fueling station, established new regulations for piers and docks (including length limits), and permitted marine supply sales along the shore.
*   **New Commercial & Infrastructure:** Authorized the construction of a drive-in gasoline station and new gas pipelines in several neighborhoods.
*   **Property Tax Adjustment:** Reduced taxes and waived penalties for an estate due to land usage for the Austin Dam reconstruction project.
